text: example demonstrates package’s capability process distorted trajectory data using straight-line movement test case: Green Dashed Line: true, ideal linear trajectory. Red Dots: Raw simulated GPS data containing standard measurement noise, multi-second signal dropout (NA gap), severe positional outlier jump (multipath simulation). Blue Line: final output computed gpscleaner. package successfully reconstructs missing data points via time-based linear interpolation deploys C-implemented 2D Kalman filter reject massive outlier jump completely, keeping path physically continuous smooth.

what: 2D Kalman Filter for GPS Coordinates — gps_noise_cleaner
title: 2D Kalman Filter for GPS Coordinates — gps_noise_cleaner
text: Filters noisy GPS coordinates using 2D Kalman filter implemented C. filter uses position velocity state variables, automatically detects rejects outliers (points 30 meters predicted position). Supports automatic conversion semicircles decimal degrees.
